class.name: OcgGraphic3dClight
class.brief_description: Generic light source definition. This class defines arbitrary light source - see Graphic3d_TypeOfLightSource enumeration. Some parameters are applicable only to particular light type; calling methods unrelated to current type will throw an exception.
class.description: ! Generic light source definition. ! This class defines arbitrary light source - see Graphic3d_TypeOfLightSource enumeration. ! Some parameters are applicable only to particular light type; ! calling methods unrelated to current type will throw an exception.

method.name: Graphic3d_CLight
method.description: Empty constructor, which should be followed by light source properties configuration.

method.name: CopyFrom
method.description: Copy parameters from another light source excluding source type.

method.name: Type
method.description: Returns the Type of the Light, cannot be changed after object construction.

method.name: Color
method.description: Returns the color of the light source; WHITE by default.

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Defines the color of a light source by giving the basic color.

method.name: IsEnabled
method.description: Check that the light source is turned on; TRUE by default. This flag affects all occurrences of light sources, where it was registered and activated; so that it is possible defining an active light in View which is actually in disabled state.

method.name: SetEnabled
method.description: Change enabled state of the light state. This call does not remove or deactivate light source in Views/Viewers; instead it turns it OFF so that it just have no effect.

method.name: ToCastShadows
method.description: Return TRUE if shadow casting is enabled; FALSE by default. Has no effect in Ray-Tracing rendering mode.

method.name: SetCastShadows
method.description: Enable/disable shadow casting.

method.name: IsHeadlight
method.description: Returns true if the light is a headlight; FALSE by default. Headlight flag means that light position/direction are defined not in a World coordinate system, but relative to the camera orientation.

method.name: Headlight
method.description: Alias for IsHeadlight().

method.name: SetHeadlight
method.description: Setup headlight flag.

method.name: Position_1
method.description: Returns location of positional/spot light; (0, 0, 0) by default.

method.name: SetPosition_1
method.description: Setup location of positional/spot light.

method.name: Position_2
method.description: Returns location of positional/spot light.

method.name: SetPosition_2
method.description: Setup location of positional/spot light.

method.name: ConstAttenuation
method.description: Returns constant attenuation factor of positional/spot light source; 1.0f by default. Distance attenuation factors of reducing positional/spot light intensity depending on the distance from its position:

method.name: LinearAttenuation
method.description: Returns linear attenuation factor of positional/spot light source; 0.0 by default. Distance attenuation factors of reducing positional/spot light intensity depending on the distance from its position:

method.name: Attenuation
method.description: Returns the attenuation factors.

method.name: SetAttenuation
method.description: Defines the coefficients of attenuation; values should be >= 0.0 and their summ should not be equal to 0.

method.name: Direction_1
method.description: Returns direction of directional/spot light.

method.name: SetDirection_1
method.description: Sets direction of directional/spot light.

method.name: Direction_2
method.description: Returns the theVx, theVy, theVz direction of the light source.

method.name: SetDirection_2
method.description: Sets direction of directional/spot light.

method.name: DisplayPosition
method.description: Returns location of positional/spot/directional light, which is the same as returned by Position().

method.name: SetDisplayPosition
method.description: Setup location of positional/spot/directional light, which is the same as SetPosition() but allows directional light source (technically having no position, but this point can be used for displaying light source presentation).

method.name: Angle
method.description: Returns an angle in radians of the cone created by the spot; 30 degrees by default.

method.name: SetAngle
method.description: Angle in radians of the cone created by the spot, should be within range (0.0, M_PI).

method.name: Concentration
method.description: Returns intensity distribution of the spot light, within [0.0, 1.0] range; 1.0 by default. This coefficient should be converted into spotlight exponent within [0.0, 128.0] range: The concentration factor determines the dispersion of the light on the surface, the default value (1.0) corresponds to a minimum of dispersion.

method.name: SetConcentration
method.description: Defines the coefficient of concentration; value should be within range [0.0, 1.0].

method.name: Intensity
method.description: Returns the intensity of light source; 1.0 by default.

method.name: SetIntensity
method.description: Modifies the intensity of light source, which should be > 0.0.

method.name: Smoothness
method.description: Returns the smoothness of light source (either smoothing angle for directional light or smoothing radius in case of positional light); 0.0 by default.

method.name: SetSmoothRadius
method.description: Modifies the smoothing radius of positional/spot light; should be >= 0.0.

method.name: SetSmoothAngle
method.description: Modifies the smoothing angle (in radians) of directional light source; should be within range [0.0, M_PI/2].

method.name: HasRange
method.description: Returns TRUE if maximum distance of point light source is defined.

method.name: Range
method.description: Returns maximum distance on which point light source affects to objects and is considered during illumination calculations. 0.0 means disabling range considering at all without any distance limits. Has sense only for point light sources (positional and spot).

method.name: SetRange
method.description: Modifies maximum distance on which point light source affects to objects and is considered during illumination calculations. Positional and spot lights are only point light sources. 0.0 means disabling range considering at all without any distance limits.

method.name: Revision
method.description: Returns modification counter

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
